The change routes classic `mort` state tables to the new `StateHeader.read`, which computes the number of states using `max(table.GlyphClassCount, 1)`. With a zero glyph-class count, the transition loop is empty, so the divisions by the glyph-class count in `_readTransition` are never reached; a suitably formed subtable can therefore decompile successfully.
YES
